WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , 1 AS __order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __cancelled_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_source_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_9.order_count) AS order_count
  , MAX(subq_9.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_16.cancel_rate) AS cancel_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30'
) subq_9
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(__cancelled_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30'
) subq_16
